qualifier: lens and cornea maturation with hyaloid vessel regression
name: Post-embryonic eye and lens maturation with hyaloid regression
rationale: All members concern later-stage eye maturation (lens fiber, cornea, eyelid, lens transparency) and developmental apoptosis/regression (retinal cell death, hyaloid plexus, vessel apoptosis), which separates it from confusables focused on embryonic optic cup/retina/iris morphogenesis, retinal vasculature or placenta.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and fusion
name: Calcium-triggered presynaptic vesicle fusion and neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover Ca2+-dependent synaptic and dense-core vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and exocytosis plus the release cycles of glutamate, GABA, monoamines and acetylcholine, whereas confusables emphasize vesicle recycling/endocytosis or postsynaptic glutamate receptor signaling.

qualifier: prefoldin and CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin
name: Prefoldin and CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All members describe de novo folding by prefoldin and the CCT/TRiC chaperonin, especially of actin and tubulin, distinct from ER folding/refolding, tubulin post-translational modification or telomerase-related confusables.

core: Antifungal innate immunity and IL-17 axis
qualifier: C-type lectin receptor sensing, IL-36/IL-38
name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-17/IL-36 inflammatory axis
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal sensing with Th17/IL-23/IL-17 induction and IL-36/IL-38 signaling, whereas confusables center on IL-10, IL-12, IL-23 and IL-27 receptor signaling or other cytokine production.

core: Vitamin and cofactor transport and metabolism
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E, ubiquinone; cytochrome P450 defects
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E metabolism and cytochrome P450 defects
rationale: Members cover transport and metabolism of vitamins B1, B2, E and ubiquinone/quinones together with inherited CYP (and SLCO2A1) defects, distinguishing it from cobalamin, coenzyme A/pantothenate and carnitine/choline confusables.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment development
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members combine sorting of cargo into the primary cilium (BBSome, VxPx, ARL13B, transition zone, basal body docking) with photoreceptor rod/cone development and outer segment organization, unlike confusables centered on intraflagellar transport, motile cilia or retinal layer formation.

qualifier: BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects and monoubiquitination control
name: Fanconi anemia crosslink repair and BRCA-linked damage response
rationale: Members center on Fanconi anemia ICL repair with its monoubiquitination/deubiquitination switch and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 loss-of-function defects, whereas confusables emphasize NHEJ, end resection, homologous recombination steps or ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: arterial, venous and lymphatic identity
name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial cell fate specification
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate commitment and differentiation into arterial, venous and lymphatic identities including dorsal aorta morphogenesis, while confusables center on vasculogenesis, vessel maturation, BMP signaling or great-artery development.

qualifier: inherited surfactant deficiency disorders
name: Pulmonary surfactant metabolism and surfactant deficiency disorders
rationale: All members concern surfactant homeostasis and its genetic defects (ABCA3, SFTPB, SFTPA2), unlike confusables on ABC lipid transporters, lipoprotein remodeling or pneumocyte differentiation.

core: Polyamine metabolism and amino acid modification
qualifier: protein methylation, hydroxylation and hypusine/diphthamide formation
name: Polyamine metabolism and protein methylation, hydroxylation, hypusination
rationale: Members combine polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport with post-translational lysine/arginine methylation, hydroxylation and translation-factor modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine), distinct from methionine salvage, tRNA aminoacylation and selenocysteine confusables.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA processing and translation
name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Nearly all members cover mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing/stability and mitoribosome translation, whereas confusables focus on nuclear tRNA processing or RNA modification chemistry.

core: Synaptic structural organization and receptor trafficking
qualifier: postsynaptic receptor endosomal recycling and synaptic cytoskeleton
name: Synaptic cytoskeleton organization and postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members span pre- and postsynaptic cytoskeleton and active-zone maintenance with endosomal trafficking and surface retention of neurotransmitter (AMPA) receptors, while confusables emphasize clathrin-mediated vesicle endocytosis or Rab/ARF signaling.

qualifier: lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
name: Peptidyl lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: All members concern methylation of lysine and arginine and hydroxylation of lysine and proline on proteins such as TP53, distinguishing it from acetylation, histone methylation and hypusine/diphthamide confusables.

qualifier: collagen fibrils and elastic fibers
name: Collagen fibril and elastic fiber assembly
rationale: All members concern organization of collagen fibrils and elastic fibers, unlike confusables centered on fibronectin, integrin adhesion, basement membrane or collagen biosynthesis.

qualifier: Rho-family GTPases (Cdc42, RHOH) and NADPH oxidase
name: Rho-family GTPase signaling in leukocyte chemotaxis and homing
rationale: Members link Cdc42/RHOH GTPase signaling, Rho-activated NADPH oxidase and PLC/PKC signaling to dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing, whereas confusables emphasize chemokine-receptor pairs or immunological synapse formation.

qualifier: netrin-DCC and ephrin cues
name: Netrin-DCC and ephrin axon guidance signaling
rationale: Members cover netrin/DCC attraction and repulsion and ephrin/EPHA growth cone collapse with Rac1 activation and fasciculation, distinct from confusables built on L1 or ROBO-SLIT guidance.

core: Viral RNA genome translation and replication
qualifier: coronavirus replicase, frameshifting and host translation subversion
name: Coronavirus genome translation, replication and host translation subversion
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation and maturation, viral frameshifting/reinitiation and capping, and viral manipulation of host translation (PKR, IFIT), whereas confusables concern influenza/RSV RNP synthesis or retroviral integration.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and degradation with PLC-calcium crosstalk
name: GPCR-regulated cAMP turnover and phospholipase C calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase regulation, cAMP synthesis and PDE1-mediated degradation together with PLC/IP3 calcium signaling, while confusables emphasize downstream PKA/CREB or adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibitory pathways.

qualifier: P-type ATPase sodium, potassium and magnesium balance
name: Na+/K+-ATPase-driven sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members concern P-type ATPase transport, glycoside response and intracellular Na+, K+ and Mg2+ homeostasis maintaining transmembrane gradients, unlike confusables centered on potassium channels, membrane potential or paracellular transport.

qualifier: replication fork reversal
name: DNA topological and geometric remodeling including replication fork reversal
rationale: All three members concern changes in DNA topology or geometry, including fork reversal, whereas confusables focus on telomere maintenance or crosslink/drug responses.

qualifier: copper and manganese, metallothionein response
name: Copper and manganese homeostasis and metallothionein metal response
rationale: Members cover copper and manganese import, homeostasis and detoxification plus MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc and iron, while confusables center on zinc transporters and cadmium detoxification.

qualifier: B cell homing and mucosal lymphoid tissue
name: Secondary lymphoid tissue development and B cell homing
rationale: Members concern lymph node and mucosa/gut-associated lymphoid tissue development with B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone differentiation and lymphocyte entry, unlike confusables on T cell and dendritic cell chemotaxis or S1P/CXCR4 signaling.

qualifier: gluconeogenesis and pancreatic beta-cell development
name: Circadian and glucocorticoid control of gluconeogenesis and beta-cell growth
rationale: Members link BMAL1:CLOCK rhythms and glucocorticoid response with gluconeogenesis, steroid/endocrine secretion and beta-cell proliferation, while confusables cover core clock machinery, PGC-1alpha/PPAR or ACTH/cortisol secretion.

name: Cytoplasmic stress granule assembly and disassembly
rationale: All members concern stress granule formation, protein recruitment and disassembly, distinct from aggrephagy and proteasomal degradation confusables.

qualifier: reduced glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
name: Negative regulation of insulin signaling and glucose uptake
rationale: All members describe dampening of insulin receptor signaling and its outputs (glucose import, glycogen synthesis), whereas confusables cover positive insulin/adiponectin effects, GLUT4 translocation or glucagon signaling.
